questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

17 + 10 × 5 ÷ 9 + 18 = 53
questions.solution:
Here, we use the BODMAS table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e10e3be1476caf1bd7e2e109842e7c57ce86da0c54b1b539e233e4e6a7748a44.png] 

Given:

⇒ 17 + 10 × 5 ÷ 9 + 18 = 53

(1) + and ÷

⇒ 17 + 10 × 5 ÷ 9 + 18 = 53

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ __**17 ÷ 10**__ × 5 + __**9 ÷ 18**__ = 53

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ __**1.7 × 5**__ + 0.5

⇒ 8.5 + 0.5 = 9

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(2) + and ×

⇒ 17 + 10 × 5 ÷ 9 + 18 = 53

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ 17 × 10 + __**5 ÷ 9**__ × 18 = 53

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ __**17 × 10**__ + __**0.55 × 18**__

⇒ 170 + 9.9 = 179.9

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(3) + and­ −

⇒ 17 + 10 × 5 ÷ 9 + 18 = 53

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ 17 - 10 × __**5 ÷ 9**__ - 18 = 53

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 17 - __**10 × 0.55**__ - 18

⇒ 17 - 5.5 - 18

⇒ 17 - 23.5 = (-6.5)

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(4)** × and ÷**

⇒ 17 + 10 × 5 ÷ 9 + 18 = 53

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ 17 + __**10 ÷ 5**__ × 9 + 18 = 53

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 17 + __**2 × 9**__ + 18 = 53

⇒ 17 + 18 + 18 = 53

⇒ **53 = 53**

⇒ '17 + 10 ÷ 5 × 9 + 18 = 53'

Here, the equation is** satisfied.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".

questions.question:
Three statements are followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the given statements.

**Statements:**

All peacocks are pigeons.

Some pigeons are pinks.

Some pinks are birds.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some pinks are peacocks.

(II) Some birds are pigeons.

(III) Some peacocks are birds.

options.text: Either conclusion I or conclusion III follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9741f75f02a018febe2685d7461de048bc4b1b6e459f77af0f00682cd8f30ac.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some pinks are peacocks. → Does not follow (There is no definite relation between pinks and peacocks. Hence, false)

(II) Some birds are pigeons. → Does not follow (There is no definite relation between birds and pigeons. Hence, false)

(III) Some peacocks are birds. → Does not follow (There is no definite relation between birds and peacocks. Hence, false)

Hence, '**None of the conclusion follow**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by four conclusions numbered I, II, III and IV. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All birds are ducks.

Some ducks are crows.

All crows are parrots.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some parrots are birds.

II. Some parrots are ducks.

III. Some crows are birds.

IV. All parrots are birds.

options.text: Only conclusions I and IV follow
Only conclusions I, II and IV follow
Only conclusions II and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af6bad421d42b95f8d34782ae65a6d810716f04e33ebb95729ea76787decb4f3.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some parrots are birds. → Does not follow (There is no definite relation between parrots and birds. Hence, false)

II. Some parrots are ducks. → **Follows **(As, Some ducks are crows and All crows are parrots)

III. Some crows are birds. → Does not follow (There is no definite relation between crows and birds. Hence, false)

IV. All parrots are birds. → Does not follow (There is no definite relation between parrots and birds. Hence, false)

Hence, ‘**Only conclusion II follows**’ is the correct answer.

Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially replace the * signs and to balance the given equation.

62 * 11 * 42 * 6 * 18 * 21 * 7
questions.solution:
Here, we use the BODMAS table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f17fe402f98bb01e6c434026861e42229a2db5fdddb9ac339c012f7a2b73afa8.png] 

Given:

⇒ 62 * 11 * 42 * 6 * 18 * 21 * 7

(1) +, −, =, ×, −, ÷

⇒ 62 * 11 * 42 * 6 * 18 * 21 * 7

After putting the signs:

⇒ 62 + 11 - 42 = 6 × 18 - __**21 ÷ 7**__

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 73 - 42 = __**6 × 18**__ - 3

⇒ 31 = 108 - 3

⇒ 31 = 105

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(2) **=, ×, ÷, −, +, ÷**

⇒ 62 * 11 * 42 * 6 * 18 * 21 * 7

After putting the signs:

⇒ 62 = 11 × __**42 ÷ 6**__ - 18 + __**21 ÷ 7**__

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 62 = __**11 × 7**__ - 18 + 3

⇒ 62 = 77 - 18 + 3

⇒ 62 = 80 - 18

⇒ **62 = 62**

Here, the equation is **satisfied.**

(3) −, +, =, ×, −, +

⇒ 62 * 11 * 42 * 6 * 18 * 21 * 7

After putting the signs:

⇒ 62 - 11 + 42 = __**6 × 18**__ - 21 + 7

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 104 - 11 = 108 - 21 + 7

⇒ 93 = 115 - 21

⇒ 93 = 94

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(4) +, −, ÷, =, ×, +

⇒ 62 * 11 * 42 * 6 * 18 * 21 * 7

After putting the signs:

⇒ 62 + 11 - __**42 ÷ 6**__ = __**18 × 21**__ + 7

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 62 + 11 - 7 = 378 + 7

⇒ 73 - 7 = 385

⇒ 66 = 385

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

Hence, the correct answer is "**=, ×, ÷, −, +, ÷**".
